ews.title: Subsea Pipeline Early Warning
ews.description: Vessels predicted at anchor around subsea pipeline corridors: danger below 500 m, warning below 1,750 m. Watch the distances, see them on the map and trace the event history.

stats.dangerHint: At anchor < {{meters}} m from a pipeline
stats.warningHint: At anchor < {{meters}} m from a pipeline
stats.pipelinesHint: Active pipeline zones (global and your organization's)
stats.pipelinesForbidden: The zone:read permission is needed to see pipelines

vessels.title: Vessels near pipelines
vessels.description: Most dangerous and nearest to a pipeline first. Select a row to see it on the map.
vessels.truncated: Showing the first {{count}} vessels. Narrow the statuses to see the others.
vessels.emptyDescription: No anchored vessel is near a pipeline. Add the "Safe" status to see every rated vessel.

table.distanceHidden: The nearest pipeline is a private zone of another organization, or there is no pipeline zone

map.label: Subsea pipeline EWS map
map.bufferMethod: Corridors drawn from the active thresholds
map.truncated: The pipeline data was cut by the zone service budgets. Some pipelines may be missing.

rule.title: How the EWS rule works
rule.fallbackSummary: The distance from the vessel to the nearest pipeline line is rated for vessels predicted at anchor only: below the danger threshold it is 0 (danger), below the warning threshold 1 (warning), otherwise 3 (safe).
rule.anchoredOnly: Only vessels with predicted navigational status 1 (at anchor) are rated; vessels under way are always safe under this rule.
rule.sourcesPending: The method sources are not loaded yet.

events.title: EWS event history
events.description: Every warning and danger recorded by the detector and how it ended (last 7 days; open events are always shown).
events.emptyDescription: New events are recorded when an anchored vessel comes too close to a pipeline.

collision.title: Collision Risk (CPA/TCPA)
collision.description: Vessel encounters whose closest point of approach (CPA) and time to it (TCPA) are risky, with their history and both vessels' tracks.

bands.title: Collision risk bands
bands.hysteresis: Hysteresis {{percent}} %: a pair keeps its band until it leaves the widened limits. Candidates within {{radius}} nm; vessels below {{sog}} kn, at anchor, moored or aground are excluded.

table.title: Vessel encounters
table.description: Newest encounters first. Select a row to see the CPA/TCPA chart and both vessels' tracks.
table.emptyHint: No vessel pair came close to the risk limits in this time range.
table.emptyFilteredHint: Widen the time range, add risk bands or clear the MMSI filter.

chart.tcpaTitle: TCPA (minutes) against the band time limits
